repos_data.description: YC (S26) | Open Computer History | Continuously record your company computer work, map your workflows, help you find work worth automating, and power your agents' context
Screen recording on macOS, from capture to delivery, no detours.
Terminal-native call recorder for macOS: system audio + mic, local files, on-device diarized transcription. No bots, no cloud.

Be present. Reprise remembers. An open-source call recorder for macOS: it notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides at about 1% CPU, and the screen if you want, to plain files. It keeps the call through a lost mic, a new headset or a crash. Native Swift, no dependencies, MIT.
